title: Incorruptible lands at #5 on the Lit Hub / American Booksellers Association Independent Press Top 40 Bestsellers: Nonfiction
summary: Lit Hub publishes the ranking, which the American Booksellers Association and the Independent Publishers Caucus compile from sales at hundreds of independent bookstores nationwide. Incorruptible entered it in the week ending 31 May 2026.
